title: Shooting Game 2 - 1v1, 2v1, 2v2 Variations
setup: 20x20 yard area. Two teams. Defending team at points A and C, attacking team at points B and D. A and C players each with a ball. One goalkeeper (use team goalies).
instructions: A passes to B. A attacks, B defends.
B must close down the ball quickly to deny the shot, delay and shoulder charge as needed.
A shoots to score. B scores by passing to the coach. Keep score.
As soon as that play is over C passes to D.
Rotation: A goes to C, C goes to A. B goes to D, D goes to B.
After a few minutes teams switch positions.
coachingPoints: Pass with pace on the ground.
Defender must close down the ball quickly, but don't dive in!
Make the defender commit to you, take a fast touch to the side, and shoot!
Attacker must dribble toward the left goal post, then take a touch to the right side to shoot with right foot.
If shooting with the left foot dribble to the right goal post, then take a touch to the left and shoot.
Dribbling to the goal post makes the defender and the goalkeeper commit there and creates space on the opposite side so you can shoot.
2v1: dribble to one goal post, and 2nd attacker overlaps to the opposide side. Do enforce the offside rule.
2v2: Try to turn it into a 2v1 situation by setting up a give-&-go or overlap, or through pass.
